column1: # Books imported before add_wikisource.py learned to drop Wikisource's

# keeps each entry's blurb, category and videos, and the paragraph count is
# unchanged, so Белая гвардия's jump points stay valid.

column6: The winter of 1918 in Kiev, where a family of officers and their friends hold to the old order as the city changes hands around them.
A former marshal of the nobility learns that his mother-in-law sewed the family jewels into one of a set of twelve chairs, and takes a charming confidence man as his partner in finding it.
In a glass city a thousand years from now, the builder of the state's first spaceship keeps a diary, and a woman with a sharp smile begins to take an interest in him.
The great schemer returns, this time on the trail of an underground Soviet millionaire who lives on a clerk's salary to avoid attention.
